name: בסיס למרחב השורות של מטריצה (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find a basis for the rowspace of the matrix

\[ {\bf A} = {{CT:0}}. \]

Enter the vectors in the basis as rows in the matrix below, adding zero rows when there are less than 5 vectors in the basis.

[[input:ans1]]
[[validation:ans1]]

How to enter: each entry in its own box: a number, a fraction (e.g. 1/2) or an expression (e.g. sqrt(2)).
generalfeedback:
The rank of the matrix {{CT:1}} is {{CT:2}}.

So we look for a set of {{CT:2}} rows from the matrix to form the basis set. Check the rank of the matrix formed by the chosen rows and if this is equal to {{CT:2}} you have found a solution.
